display.title: Everyone Can Build a Sukkah, and a Guest Is Its Finest Decoration
display.summary_short: Why the mitzvah of sukkah is one that everyone, young and old, can help build, and why a guest is the most beautiful sukkah decoration.
display.summary_long: A short Sukkos talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded the day before Erev Sukkos. Uncle Yossi describes the final preparations: the four kinds and the finishing touches on the sukkah. He explains that some mitzvos, like writing a mezuzah or a Sefer Torah or making tefillin, can only be done by trained experts, but everyone can join in building a sukkah: putting up boards and walls, laying the s'chach and decorating it as beautifully as possible, as our Sages teach on the verse 'This is my G-d and I will glorify Him'. Then he asks the children to guess the most beautiful sukkah decoration of all: a guest, especially a friend or relative who has no sukkah of his own. Sharing the mitzvah this way is Ahavas Yisroel, and Hashem blesses it with a good year.
display.lesson: Everyone can help build the sukkah, and inviting a guest who has no sukkah is its most beautiful decoration.
